definition: Contiguous alpha >= 0.98 front from original bore; volume-weighted radial-row means; linear interpolation between centres. Deleted rows retain their accepted alpha. Not material removal.

recovery.authorization: Explicit user request to update report and restart after exit -1
recovery.cause: Unexplained MAPDL exit -1 during result finalization; not a POST1 rejection
recovery.restart_scope: Setup/header validation only; successful next accepted step required to demonstrate continuation

wall_clock_estimate.method: Mean of last 10/20/30 intervals between ordinary accepted post-restart steps (both indices > 424). Includes subsequent wall-clock slowdowns; excludes recovery and first post-restart acceptance intervals. Conservative remaining whole-step workload from capture, without subtracting downtime or current-step age. Not a confidence interval.
